# QQAI — agent-readable project description

QQAI is a token project on BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56). Its token, $QQAI, is distributed
by DIRECT CONTRACT MINT. It is not an NFT, it is not sold on a bonding curve, and there is
no presale and no private round. Every mint — free and paid — is gated by a Binance
Agent ID, verified on-chain at mint time. Identity in QQAI is shown by Agent ID name,
never by wallet address.

Website: https://qqai-bnb.pages.dev
Machine-readable data: https://qqai-bnb.pages.dev/agent.json
Official X: https://x.com/QQAgent_BNB (@QQAgent_BNB)

## Status

Contracts DEPLOYED; sale PRE-LAUNCH. The QQAI contracts are deployed and verified on
BNB Smart Chain (Sourcify exact match, 2026-11-25):
- Token (QQAIToken):     0x69b8cA186337701262310079C14a715387338888
- Mint (QQAIMint):       0x313eedfBb409A886F55203AEEb7270CF77B65DfF
- Vesting (QQAIVesting): 0xd46313C4A48902108743eD74B5C700909Dc7d35F
The sale itself is NOT open yet: the mint contract rejects every mint before the
start time below. Any other $QQAI address is not official.

Sale opens: Nov 26, 2026, 18:00 (UTC+8) — 10:00 UTC — unix 1795687200.

## Token

- Symbol: QQAI. Standard: ERC-20, 18 decimals.
- Max supply: 1,000,000,000,000 (1 trillion), HARD CAP enforced by the token contract.
- Allocations:
  - Public sale:        675,000,000,000 (67.5%)
      - Free mint bucket:   9,157,500,000
      - Paid mint bucket: 665,842,500,000
  - Liquidity reserve:  225,000,000,000 (22.5%)
  - Team:                50,000,000,000 (5%) — vesting: 365-day cliff, then linear over 4 years
  - Reserve:             50,000,000,000 (5%)

## Free mint

Free mint: 16,500,000 QQAI — entry gate fee 0.0001 BNB.
- The 16,500,000 QQAI are free. The 0.0001 BNB is an entry gate fee, charged per mint
  (plus network gas). It is the only cost of a free mint.
- Max 2 free mints per Agent ID (up to 33,000,000 QQAI per identity).
- Total free mints: 555, first come first served. When 555 is reached, the free mint
  closes permanently.
- Free bucket: 9,157,500,000 QQAI (= 555 x 16,500,000), reserved inside the public
  allocation; the paid sale cannot touch it.

## Paid mint — pre-pool ladder (batches 1-4)

- Paid mint runs in batches of 1,111 mints. A batch must fill before the next opens.
- Price steps +5% per batch, package steps -5% per batch:
  - Batch 1: 50,000,000 QQAI per mint — 0.003 BNB
  - Batch 2: 47,500,000 QQAI per mint — 0.00315 BNB
  - Batch 3: 45,125,000 QQAI per mint — 0.0033075 BNB
  - Batch 4: 42,868,750 QQAI per mint — 0.003472875 BNB
- Max 10 paid mints per Agent ID (counted in mints, all phases).
- EVERY paid mint delivers the package x 1.05 — the +5% Agent ID token bonus (see below).
  Delivered amounts batches 1-4: 52,500,000 / 49,875,000 / 47,381,250 / 45,012,187.5 QQAI.
- Proceeds split on every paid mint: 80% to the market side, 20% to development
  (public split of the 20%: 10% buy back & burn + 5% liquidity + 5% team).
  Pre-pool, the 80% is held by the mint contract as the pool seed.
  ESCROW RULE: before the pool opens, NOTHING is paid out — no per-mint and no
  per-batch payout. The full proceeds stay inside the mint contract, and the split
  runs exactly once, at the pool opening: the 80% seeds the pool and the accumulated
  20% development share is released at that same moment.
- Pre-pool totals if batches 1-4 sell out: gross 14.365646625 BNB; development 20% =
  2.873129325 BNB; pool seed 80% = 11.4925173 BNB.

## Pool opening — automatic at paid mint #4,444

- The paid mint that completes batch 4 (paid mint #4,444 overall) automatically creates
  the PancakeSwap V2 pair QQAI/WBNB in the same transaction and seeds it with:
  - 11.4925173 BNB (the held 80% of pre-pool proceeds, at full sell-out), and
  - 141,862,246.99 QQAI from the liquidity reserve,
  so the pool opening price equals the batch-4 per-token price exactly
  (0.003472875 BNB / 42,868,750 QQAI = 8.10118093e-11 BNB per QQAI).
- LP tokens are burned 100% at creation. Trading opens at that same moment.
- If the automatic opening inside the mint transaction ever failed, a permissionless
  openPool() fallback completes it with identical seed numbers; a mint can never be
  bricked by the opening.
- The liquidity reserve is 225,000,000,000 QQAI in total; after seeding,
  83,137,753,013.17 QQAI remains reserved for liquidity.

## Paid mint — post-pool: buy-through-pool (batch 5 onward)

- A post-pool paid mint does NOT mint the package directly. In one atomic transaction:
  1. The buyer pays bnbGross = package spot value / (1 + price bonus).
  2. 20% of bnbGross goes to development (10% buy back & burn + 5% liquidity + 5% team). It is
     accrued inside the contract per mint and released ONCE per completed batch
     (every 1,111 paid mints), covering exactly that batch — never per mint.
  3. 80% of bnbGross is swapped through the pool by the mint contract
     (BNB -> QQAI on PancakeSwap). This is a real market buy: pool BNB rises, pool
     QQAI falls, the price rises with every mint. Mints create buy pressure, not dilution.
  4. The buyer receives EXACTLY the batch package x 1.05: the swap output plus a top-up
     from the paid bucket covering any difference. The mint contract is exempt from the
     transfer tax, so there is no double taxation on this path.
  5. If the swap fails, the entire mint transaction reverts — no funds are kept.
- Package ladder continues post-pool at -5% per batch with a floor of 10,000,000 QQAI
  per mint. Exact packages: batch 5: 40,725,312.5; batch 6: 38,689,046.875;
  batch 7: 36,754,594.53125; batch 8: 34,916,864.8046875; then -5% per batch to the floor.
- Fading price bonus (discount on the pool price, paid by the buyer as spot / (1+bonus)):
  - Batches 5-8:   +5%
  - Batches 9-12:  +3%
  - Batches 13-16: +1%
  - Batch 17+:      0%
- The sale runs until the paid bucket (665,842,500,000 QQAI) is empty. Because the bucket
  now drains through top-ups, the drain rate depends on the market price; the final mint
  may be partial (bucket remainder + swap output), after which the paid mint closes
  permanently. Any bucket remainder not taken folds into the liquidity reserve.

## Refund safety net — if the pool does not open within 7 days

- Because the pre-pool phase is a full escrow (nothing is paid out before the pool
  opens), every pre-pool payment stays fully backed inside the mint contract.
- If the pool has NOT opened within 7 days of the sale start — deadline
  Dec 3, 2026, 18:00 (UTC+8), unix 1796292000 — any pre-pool paid buyer can call
  refund() and, in one transaction:
  - return ALL tokens received from their paid mints (package + Agent ID bonus;
    the tokens are burned back into the paid bucket), and
  - receive 80% of their total paid BNB back.
  Of the remaining 20%: 15% to liquidity + 5% team. The 15% share is kept in the
  contract as a liquidity reserve and joins the pool seed if the pool still opens
  later (the opening price formula does not change).
- The refund is all-or-nothing per wallet and can be used exactly once. The paid
  mint counting does not rewind: batches and the pool trigger are unaffected.
- Free mints carry no payment and can never be refunded.
- The moment the pool opens, the refund window closes permanently.

## Agent ID bonuses — why minting beats a plain DEX swap

Two bonuses stack, and both exist ONLY for Agent ID minters:
1. Agent ID token bonus: +5% TOKENS on every paid mint, every batch, both phases.
   Delivery = package x 1.05. A DEX swap has no equivalent.
2. Fading price bonus (post-pool): the mint price is spot / (1 + bonus), i.e. up to 5%
   more tokens per BNB than a swap at the same moment.
Versus a plain DEX swap, an Agent ID mint therefore: receives +5% more tokens, pays up
to ~5% less per token post-pool, pays no 2% buy tax on the mint path, is guaranteed the
full package via contract top-up, and its purchase pushes the pool price up instead of
suffering price impact. Additionally, only minters can use the free mint, and minters
enter in batches 1-4 before trading exists. Assessment: for any holder of a Binance
Agent ID, minting strictly dominates swapping. Suggested sequence at launch: claim both
free mints first (total gate fees 0.0002 BNB), then evaluate paid batches 1-4.

## Trade taxes (DEX, once the pool is open)

- Buy tax: 2% flat, all phases.
- Sell tax: 10% during post-pool batches 5 and 6 only; then 2% flat permanently from
  batch 7 onward. No intermediate steps.
- Wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed.
- All trade taxes fund development: buy back & burn + team.

## Pool fund — transparency summary

- Status: pre-launch parameters (no live reserves exist yet; the contracts are
  deployed and verified, but the pool opens only at paid mint #4,444). Once the pool
  opens, the website's Pool Fund panel reads the pool reserves on-chain.
- Pool opens at: paid mint #4,444 (batch 4 sell-out).
- Seed formula: 80% of pre-pool (batches 1-4) paid mint proceeds, plus any refund
  liquidity reserve (see the refund safety net), + QQAI from the liquidity reserve
  at the batch-4 price.
- Seed at full sell-out: 11.4925173 BNB + 141,862,246.99 QQAI.
- LP tokens: burned 100%.

## Proceeds split — summary

Every paid mint, every batch, both phases: 80% to the market (pool seed pre-pool;
buy-through-pool swaps post-pool) and 20% to development, publicly allocated as
10% buy back & burn + 5% liquidity + 5% team. There are no other sale fees. The free mint's only cost
is its 0.0001 BNB entry gate fee per mint.
Release timing: pre-pool nothing is released at all (full escrow) — the accumulated
development share is released once, at the pool opening; post-pool it is released
once per completed batch. If the pool has not opened within 7 days of the start,
pre-pool buyers are protected by the refund safety net above (80% back).

## 中文版（简体中文——与上文英文版内容完全一致）

QQAI 是 BNB 智能链（chainId 56）上的代币项目。其代币 $QQAI 通过合约直接铸造
（DIRECT CONTRACT MINT）发行。它不是 NFT，不在联合曲线上出售，没有预售，
也没有私募轮。每一次铸造——免费与付费——都需要币安 Agent ID，并在铸造时
于链上验证。在 QQAI 中，身份以 Agent ID 名称显示，永远不显示钱包地址。

官网：https://qqai-bnb.pages.dev
机器可读数据：https://qqai-bnb.pages.dev/agent.json
官方 X：https://x.com/QQAgent_BNB（@QQAgent_BNB）

### 状态

合约已部署；销售发售前（PRE-LAUNCH）。QQAI 合约已在 BNB 智能链上部署并完成
验证（Sourcify 完全匹配，2026年11月25日）：
- 代币（QQAIToken）：0x69b8cA186337701262310079C14a715387338888
- 铸造（QQAIMint）：0x313eedfBb409A886F55203AEEb7270CF77B65DfF
- 释放（QQAIVesting）：0xd46313C4A48902108743eD74B5C700909Dc7d35F
销售本身尚未开启：铸造合约在下方开始时间之前拒绝一切铸造。
任何其他 $QQAI 地址都不是官方的。

开售时间：2026年11月26日 18:00（UTC+8）——10:00 UTC——unix 1795687200。

### 代币

- 代码：QQAI。标准：ERC-20，18 位小数。
- 最大供应量：1,000,000,000,000（1万亿），由代币合约强制执行的硬顶（HARD CAP）。
- 分配：
  - 公开销售：        675,000,000,000（67.5%）
      - 免费铸造桶：    9,157,500,000
      - 付费铸造桶：    665,842,500,000
  - 流动性储备：        225,000,000,000（22.5%）
  - 团队：              50,000,000,000（5%）——释放安排：365 天悬崖期，之后 4 年线性释放
  - 储备：              50,000,000,000（5%）

### 免费铸造

免费铸造：每次 16,500,000 QQAI——入场费 0.0001 BNB。
- 16,500,000 QQAI 本身免费。0.0001 BNB 是入场费，按次收取（另加网络 gas）。
  这是免费铸造的唯一成本。
- 每个 Agent ID 最多免费铸造 2 次（每个身份最多 33,000,000 QQAI）。
- 免费铸造总共 555 次，先到先得。达到 555 次后，免费铸造永久关闭。
- 免费桶：9,157,500,000 QQAI（= 555 × 16,500,000），预留于公开发售分配之内；
  付费销售不能动用它。

### 付费铸造——池前阶梯（第 1–4 批）

- 付费铸造每批 1,111 次。一批必须售满，下一批才会开启。
- 价格每批 +5%，每份数量每批 −5%：
  - 第 1 批：每份 50,000,000 QQAI——0.003 BNB
  - 第 2 批：每份 47,500,000 QQAI——0.00315 BNB
  - 第 3 批：每份 45,125,000 QQAI——0.0033075 BNB
  - 第 4 批：每份 42,868,750 QQAI——0.003472875 BNB
- 每个 Agent ID 最多付费铸造 10 次（按铸造次数计算，涵盖所有阶段）。
- 每一次付费铸造到账均为每份数量 × 1.05——即 +5% Agent ID 代币奖励（见下文）。
  第 1–4 批到账数量：52,500,000 / 49,875,000 / 47,381,250 / 45,012,187.5 QQAI。
- 每次付费铸造的收入分配：80% 进入市场一侧，20% 用于发展
  （20% 的公开分配为：10% 回购销毁 + 5% 流动性 + 5% 团队）。
  池前阶段，这 80% 由铸造合约留存，作为池子种子。
  托管规则：开池之前，任何款项都不会支付出去——既不按次、也不按批支付。
  全部收入都留存在铸造合约内，分配只在开池时执行一次：80% 注入池子，
  累计的 20% 发展份额在同一时刻释放。
- 若第 1–4 批售罄，池前总计：总收入 14.365646625 BNB；发展 20% =
  2.873129325 BNB；池子种子 80% = 11.4925173 BNB。

### 开池——在付费铸造第 4,444 次时自动开启

- 完成第 4 批的那次付费铸造（即总第 4,444 次付费铸造）会在同一笔交易中
  自动创建 PancakeSwap V2 的 QQAI/WBNB 交易对，并注入：
  - 11.4925173 BNB（售罄时留存的池前收入的 80%），以及
  - 流动性储备中的 141,862,246.99 QQAI，
  因此开盘价与第 4 批每枚代币价格完全一致
  （0.003472875 BNB / 42,868,750 QQAI = 每枚 QQAI 8.10118093e-11 BNB）。
- LP 代币在创建时 100% 销毁。交易在同一时刻开启。
- 若铸造交易内的自动开池万一失败，无需许可的 openPool() 备用函数会以完全
  相同的种子数字完成开池；铸造永远不会因开池而被卡死。
- 流动性储备总共 225,000,000,000 QQAI；注资后，还剩
  83,137,753,013.17 QQAI 继续预留作流动性。

### 付费铸造——开池后：经池买入（第 5 批起）

- 开池后的付费铸造不会直接铸造每份数量。在一笔原子交易中：
  1. 买家支付 bnbGross = 每份现价价值 /（1 + 价格奖励）。
  2. bnbGross 的 20% 用于发展（10% 回购销毁 + 5% 流动性 + 5% 团队）。该份额按每次铸造
     在合约内累计，每个批次完成时（每 1,111 次付费铸造）一次性释放，
     恰好覆盖该批次——绝不按次释放。
  3. bnbGross 的 80% 由铸造合约通过池子兑换（在 PancakeSwap 上 BNB -> QQAI）。
     这是真实的市场买入：池中 BNB 上升、池中 QQAI 下降，每次铸造价格都随之
     上涨。铸造产生的是买压，而不是稀释。
  4. 买家收到的恰好是每份数量 × 1.05：兑换所得加上付费桶补足的差额。
     铸造合约免于转账税，因此这条路径上不存在双重征税。
  5. 若兑换失败，整笔铸造交易回滚——不保留任何资金。
- 每份数量阶梯在开池后继续每批 −5%，下限为每份 10,000,000 QQAI。
  精确每份数量：第 5 批 40,725,312.5；第 6 批 38,689,046.875；
  第 7 批 36,754,594.53125；第 8 批 34,916,864.8046875；之后每批 −5% 直到下限。
- 递减价格奖励（对池价的折扣，买家按 现价 /（1+奖励）支付）：
  - 第 5–8 批：   +5%
  - 第 9–12 批：  +3%
  - 第 13–16 批： +1%
  - 第 17 批起：  0%
- 销售持续到付费桶（665,842,500,000 QQAI）耗尽为止。由于桶现在通过补足
  消耗，消耗速度取决于市场价格；最后一次铸造可能只成交一部分（桶中剩余 +
  兑换所得），之后付费铸造永久关闭。桶中未被取走的剩余将并入流动性储备。

### 退款安全网——若 7 天内未开池

- 由于池前阶段为全额托管（开池前不支付任何款项），每一笔池前付款都由
  铸造合约内的资金全额支撑。
- 若开售后 7 天内池子仍未开启——截止时间 2026年12月3日 18:00（UTC+8），
  unix 1796292000——任何池前付费买家都可以调用 refund()，在一笔交易中：
  - 返还其付费铸造所收到的全部代币（每份数量 + Agent ID 奖励；
    代币将被销毁并回到付费桶），并且
  - 取回其所付 BNB 总额的 80%。
  剩余 20% 中：15% 流动性 + 5% 团队。其中 15% 份额作为流动性储备
  留存在合约内；若池子之后仍开启，它将并入池子种子（开盘价公式不变）。
- 退款按钱包全额执行（不可部分退款），且每个钱包只能使用一次。
  付费铸造计数不会回退：批次与开池触发不受影响。
- 免费铸造没有付款，永远不能退款。
- 池子开启的那一刻，退款窗口永久关闭。

### Agent ID 奖励——为什么铸造胜过普通 DEX 兑换

两项奖励可以叠加，且都只属于 Agent ID 铸造者：
1. Agent ID 代币奖励：每次付费铸造 +5% 代币，每个批次、两个阶段都有。
   到账 = 每份数量 × 1.05。DEX 兑换没有与之对应的东西。
2. 递减价格奖励（开池后）：铸造价格为 现价 /（1 + 奖励），即同一时刻每 BNB
   比兑换多出最高约 5% 的代币。
因此，与普通 DEX 兑换相比，Agent ID 铸造：多收 +5% 代币；开池后每枚代币
支付最高约少 5%；铸造路径不付 2% 买入税；由合约补足保证完整每份数量；
其买入推高池价，而不是承受价格冲击。此外，只有铸造者能使用免费铸造，
且铸造者在交易存在之前的第 1–4 批即可进入。评估：对任何币安 Agent ID
持有者而言，铸造严格优于兑换。发售时的建议顺序：先领满两次免费铸造
（入场费总计 0.0002 BNB），再评估第 1–4 批付费铸造。

### 交易税（DEX，池子开启后）

- 买入税：2%，固定，所有阶段。
- 卖出税：仅在开池后第 5 和第 6 批为 10%；第 7 批起永久固定 2%。
  没有中间档位。
- 钱包间转账免税。
- 所有交易税都用于发展：回购销毁 + 团队。

### 池子资金——透明度摘要

- 状态：发售前参数（尚无实时储备；合约已部署并完成验证，但池子要到付费铸造
  第 4,444 次才开启）。开池后，官网的池子资金面板将读取链上池储备。
- 开池时点：付费铸造第 4,444 次（第 4 批售罄）。
- 种子公式：池前（第 1–4 批）付费铸造收入的 80%，加上任何退款流动性储备
  （见退款安全网），再加按第 4 批价格从流动性储备配对的 QQAI。
- 售罄时种子：11.4925173 BNB + 141,862,246.99 QQAI。
- LP 代币：100% 销毁。

### 收入分配——摘要

每次付费铸造、每个批次、两个阶段：80% 进入市场（池前为池子种子；开池后为
经池买入兑换），20% 用于发展，公开发布的分配为 10% 回购销毁 + 5% 流动性 + 5% 团队。
没有其他销售费用。免费铸造的唯一成本是每次 0.0001 BNB 入场费。
释放时点：池前阶段完全不释放（全额托管）——累计的发展份额在开池时一次性
释放；开池后则在每个批次完成时释放一次。若开售后 7 天内池子仍未开启，
池前买家受上述退款安全网保护（返还 80%）。
